name: Cut and Run
description: Get three strongboxes out of the Kettle's north wall and down the south road before the Concord audit seals them.
briefing: Sled-log. The Concord killed Hesk Varrow on market day last week, in the aisles, in front of everybody. Varrow was a forger and nobody misses him. What they miss is the rule that said the Concord could not do that.

Now the Concord has decided it likes the Kettle. Toll-agents at the north gaps with a ledger and a warrant for "contraband", which means anything in a strongbox. Our strongboxes are under the north wall, because the north wall is the shady side. Three haulers, three sleds, and the dogs ran.
Get the boxes to the south road. Do not fight in the open aisles if you can help it, because the market will remember who started it. I would like the market to remember it was them.
victoryText: The sleds go out the south road with the toll-agents shouting audit numbers after them. Brask counts the boxes twice, then a third time. His own box, the small iron one with the lock he never lets anyone see, is not among them. Somebody saw a red-throated bird over the north wall. Brask sits down very carefully.
defeatText: The boxes are sealed with Concord wax and carried up the Stair. Brask spends a month buying back his own receipts, one at a time, at Concord prices.

victory.label: Get the strongboxes to the south road

defeat.label: Do not lose all three haulers
Clear the south road before turn 12

do.speaker: Toll-Captain Merrit Sax
do.text: By order of the Marshals' Office, this market is under audit. Please remain where you are. Please remain.

do.speaker: Scout
do.text: Two Causeway Outriders come round the rim, cutting at the south road.

do.speaker: Odo Brask
do.text: I've paid the south gate-ward. He's honest, so it may take him a turn to look away.
